question: Which city is constructing a 27-metre-tall clock tower at Talkatora Roundabout to enhance its architectural identity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The construction of a **27-metre-tall clock tower** is a project initiated in **New Delhi** at the **Talkatora Roundabout**.
 
• The purpose of this clock tower is to **enhance the architectural identity** and aesthetic appeal of the city, which is renowned for its historical landmarks.
 
• This project aims to blend **modern architecture** with **traditional aesthetics**, symbolizing New Delhi’s cultural and historical heritage.
 
• The location, **Talkatora Roundabout**, is a prominent intersection in New Delhi and is strategically chosen to maximize visibility and accessibility.
 
• The clock tower is expected to become a key **tourist attraction** and a **landmark** in the capital city, adding to its charm and urban landscape.
 
• New Delhi, being the capital of India, is known for its focus on **urban development**, and this project aligns with its continuous efforts to modernize its infrastructure while preserving its cultural ethos.
 
• This initiative also reflects the city's vision of promoting tourism and enhancing the experience of both residents and visitors. *Hence, the correct answer is New Delhi.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **New Delhi:**

 
 
• **New Delhi** is the **capital city of India** and serves as the center of the government and administrative activities.
 
• It is known for its blend of **historical landmarks**, such as the **India Gate**, **Rashtrapati Bhavan**, and **Qutub Minar**, along with modern infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Clock Towers in India:**
 
 
• **Clock towers** have historically been constructed in India as symbols of urban development and civic pride.
 
• Examples include the **Husainabad Clock Tower** in Lucknow, which is one of the tallest clock towers in India, and the **Rajabai Clock Tower** in Mumbai, known for its Gothic architecture.
 
 
 
• **Architectural Significance:**
 
 
• The incorporation of clock towers in modern cities symbolizes the connection between **historical architecture** and **contemporary designs**.
 
• These structures also serve as **functional landmarks** and contribute to city aesthetics, making them tourist attractions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Historical Clock Towers in India:**

 
 
• **Husainabad Clock Tower:** Located in Lucknow, it is a 67-meter tall structure built in 1881 by the British during colonial rule.
 
• **Rajabai Clock Tower:** Situated in Mumbai, this 85-meter tall tower was built in 1878 and is inspired by the Big Ben of London.
 
 
 
• **Urban Development in New Delhi:**
 
 
• New Delhi has witnessed numerous **urban projects** aimed at improving infrastructure, such as the **Delhi Metro**, **flyovers**, and **green initiatives**.
 
• The construction of the 27-meter clock tower aligns with the city's vision of becoming a world-class urban center while preserving its historical identity.
